negative_findings.description: Every automated fetch of bank.gov.ua (both /ua/supervision/registers and /ua/... paths) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, as did the data.gov.ua organisation HTML page.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page body retrieved from the NBU site during this scout. Content is nonetheless search-indexed and cross-referenced by law firms and press, so the hypothesis is bot defence (WAF/Cloudflare-style) rather than removal. NOT recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must assume browser-emulating fetch or a headless browser for bank.gov.ua, and the CKAN API rather than HTML for data.gov.ua. A naive scraper will silently collect nothing.

negative_findings.description: No stable, directly-citable download URL for the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури (Register of Payment Infrastructure) file itself was located from search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for the register name plus 'xlsx'/'завантажити' surfaced the landing page, the governing NBU regulation and press coverage, but no confirmed file link. By contrast the DRFU register file path (bank.gov.ua/files/N_bank/r_drfu/ree_fu.xlsx) was reported via a data.gov.ua resource description.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The RPI is the single most important register for this run's payments scope; its collection endpoint must be resolved by rendering https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps in a real browser before the pipeline is built.

negative_findings.description: No separate public register listing authorised open-banking TPPs (AISP/PISP) as its own artefact was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legal and industry sources consistently state that TPPs are authorised as providers of non-financial payment services and are entered into the general Register of Payment Infrastructure, receiving an electronic certificate for bank API access — i.e. the open-banking population is a subset of RPI, not a standalone list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any expectation of a discrete 'TPP register' page would produce a false negative. Open-banking actor tracking must be implemented as a filter over the RPI plus NBU licence-grant news, with Ukraine's open banking framework live since 1 August 2025 and bank API compliance due in early 2026.

negative_findings.description: EDR open-data publication was suspended during the war and only restored on 19 January 2026 under a Ministry of Justice order of 18 November 2025, with wartime-risk redactions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access exists again but the dataset is not a like-for-like restoration of the pre-2022 content; some fields are withheld for security reasons.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical continuity of ownership data for Ukrainian banks and PSPs is broken across 2022-2025; any longitudinal ownership analysis needs to flag that gap rather than infer change.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (uk) search was used for the majority of queries in this cell and was decisively more productive than English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian queries surfaced the KIS NBU system, the regulation.gov.ua function catalogue, the legacy old.bank.gov.ua directories, the DRFU dataset resource path and the FGVFO sub-registers — none of which appeared in the English-language result sets, which returned mostly law-firm commentary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the mandate: an English-only scout of Ukrainian registers would have missed the actual data surfaces and returned only secondary commentary.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated e-money issuer register or card-scheme/processor list was separately identified beyond the RPI.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian terms for e-money issuers (емітент електронних грошей) and payment-infrastructure service operators were noted in the regulation.gov.ua function description but not chased to a distinct published list within this cell's budget.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a residual possibility that a discrete e-money or processor sub-register exists as a separate NBU page; should be resolved when the RPI page is rendered.

brief: Ukraine's register landscape for banking and payments is centralised and unusually well-structured: the NBU owns the two decisive surfaces — the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури (payment systems, participants, technological operators, commercial agents, and by extension open-banking TPPs) and the КІС НБУ online registers holding the Державний реєстр фінансових установ — while a bank-and-branch directory API and the NBUStatService REST OpenData service provide machine-readable identifier and statistics planes. The critical operational finding is access, not existence: bank.gov.ua returned HTTP 403 to every automated fetch attempted here, and the data.gov.ua HTML pages did too, so this cell's collection must run through browser-emulating fetchers plus the data.gov.ua CKAN API (package_show/package_search), which mirrors the DRFU and, since 19 January 2026, the restored EDR company register. The register picture is completed from the negative side by the Deposit Guarantee Fund's lists of insolvent and liquidated banks and by the NSDC State Register of Sanctions (with OpenSanctions as a normalised mirror), and expanded indirectly by commercial aggregators (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity Project) that resell the same state registers with change-tracking. Local-language search was clearly decisive — the actual data surfaces surfaced only under Ukrainian terminology, while English queries returned law-firm commentary.
